positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Developed Reporting Portal using Angular 1 and Java. The Portal Provides Avis Managers with Real Time Information about Car Rentals previously only available when a batch ran. Responsibilities included development of numerous REST services using the Spring Framework, as well as the designing the UI of the portal

Enhanced Gate Exit Service using Java and Spring Boot. Before this enhancement a customer was not able to exchange a vehicle after they checked out the car. With this new enhancement the customer was able to exchange cars when they came for pickup, because now a Rest call would be triggered that would disable the option to exchange the car after the customer has successfully left with it. Also, created an excel report and a PDF report that would be sent out to business that would show all the transactions that would happen for a particular location and region using POI and iTextPDF dependencies
